edition_and_clock.policy: V1.0 created 2018-08, V2.0 changed error-correction language in 2020-03 (both month precision). V3.0 becomes effective on publication: notice 15198 dated 2024-03-29 (day). Catalogue PDF and notice attachment identical by SHA-256. Earlier rule bodies and subsequent sunset not established here.
edition_and_clock.policy_sections: Physical PDF pp. 2, 6–7 (§2.4, §3.3). Errors found after six months generally receive no action. Within six months correction is assessed case by case. Recalculation/republication triggers client notification. Closing levels generally publish each index trading day; no hour or guaranteed finality. Do not back-apply V3.0 to 2017, 2018 or 2020.
edition_and_clock.acquisition_clocks: Per-body UTC complete-read and post-fsync timestamps in reconciliation.sources, also in <raw-name>.json sidecars. Catalogue itemDate and HTTP headers are not receipt timestamps.
